art_direction: 暖燕麦底，鸭卵青侧带，外缘笔压稍厚，左下望。
composition_variation: Use comfortable medium spacing and a subtly lowered left opening. The right eye is eight percent higher and broader. Both pupils turn softly left and down, staying coordinated. Make the upper brush pressure fuller toward the outer third rather than the inner corner, with flowing tapered edges. Keep matching #A6C8BF iris side bands and one long narrow ivory glint per black pupil. Use a clearly visible but gentle warm oat beige paper background, matching the exact palette below. Do not wash it out to white. Keep it flat and quiet with no gradients or decorative marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
